title: G4: D13 call-bookmark diagram (M)
description:
A diagram view that shows a call as a bookmark: where the machine will come back to.
Acceptance:
- Given a program with a call, the D13 diagram shows the bookmark and the return point.
- It updates as steps run and has a reduced-motion caption.
- A lesson scene can request D13.
right_now_summary: No recent activity is reported on the D13 call-bookmark diagram.
